entities.summary: Abd al Wahid Pallavicini was a leading figure of Sufism in Europe. In France, he founded the Institut des hautes études islamiques (IHEI), in Lyon, the Italian Islamic Religious Community (COREIS), and the Academy of Interreligious Studies.
